rebuild_intent.summary: A symmetrical multi-story blocky structure surrounded by four tall corner towers with overhanging caps. The central mass is a stepped rectangular building of approximately four visible floors with a pitched red-tiled roof; white horizontal trim and small square windows repeat on each level. Towers are tall square pillars with light-colored faces and darker vertical stripes, capped by shallow hip-like red tile tops with stone edges. The whole sits on a raised brown foundation pad with spaced white corner/edge blocks.
